brief:
Ayman Odeh, head of the Arab Joint List parliamentary faction, pledged to work toward removing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government from power, the Ma'an news agency reported. Odeh made the commitment as part of the opposition bloc's broader political strategy against the current administration.

The Arab Joint List represents Palestinian citizens of Israel and has long positioned itself as a vocal opposition force in the Knesset. The faction's stated goal reflects deepening tensions between Israel's governing coalition and minority-led parliamentary opposition groups.

title: Arab Joint List leader vows to topple Netanyahu government
